New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-mobile-payment-method-messaging-element-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-inapp-payment-method-messaging-element-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-payment-method-messaging-element.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/payment-method-messaging-element`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/payment-method-messaging-element, November says the mobile Payment Method Messaging Element automatically explains buy now, pay later options. It links iOS, Android and React Native twice, for three distinct destinations. It gives no platform prerequisites, SDK version, API object, configuration, supported plan list or confirmation outcomes (new raw lines 5-23). The April 22 capture has iOS and Android summaries describing a customizable drop-in UI that determines available plans and conditions, generates a localized description, and displays it in the app. Its two sections repeat a screenshot and link to their respective Display BNPL messaging guides (old raw lines 8-28). source-stripe-inapp-payment-method-messaging-element.md accurately summarizes April’s UI purpose, but its iOS/Android-only wording requires a capture date, and the separate implementation guide it calls un-ingested already has a mapped source. The component presents potential plans. Rendering does not create a payment or verify financing approval.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobile/payment-method-messaging-element, replacing the April summary bodies and image with a duplicated index is navigational. React Native is a new documentation route, and the repeated index introduces no additional platform or confirmed runtime behavior (new raw lines 9-23). Keep the April native drop-in, plan/conditions and localization prose, screenshot and iOS/Android guide links dated in source-stripe-inapp-payment-method-messaging-element.md (old raw lines 8-28). Repair the reciprocal link to source-stripe-inapp-display-bnpl-messaging.md. Its separate November index lists UIKit, SwiftUI, Android and React Native, with April's preview implementation details in its old guide. The 0.65.0 changelog announces React Native public preview, and retained @stripe/stripe-react-native 0.82.0 source separately exports the component and labels it Public Preview with loaded, loading, no_content and failed UI states. These are versioned records, distinct from the link and from general availability. Scope publishable-key/native setup details to the old companion examples and the no-clientSecret example and provider list to Web Elements. None establishes a universal PaymentIntent rule or authorizes, confirms, captures or settles payment.
